description:
The Huffy North Peak 26" Mountain Bike is designed for riders ready to explore beyond the sidewalk. A durable steel frame delivers strength and stability for neighborhood rides, park paths, and light trails. Whether you're cruising around town or discovering new weekend routes, North Peak is built to keep up with every ride.
A 15-speed drivetrain with easy-to-use twist shifting helps riders find the right gear for changing terrain. Climb hills, cruise flats, and maintain your momentum with smooth, reliable shifting that keeps every ride feeling controlled and capable.
Linear pull brakes provide dependable stopping power when the trail turns or the ride speeds up. Combined with wide 26-inch all-terrain tires that grip pavement, gravel, and dirt, the North Peak delivers stable handling and confident control wherever the ride leads.

components.description: Linear Pull Brakes: Responsive braking provides dependable stopping power for confident control on every ride.
Wide 26-inch tires grip pavement, gravel, and dirt to keep rides steady and comfortable.
